purpose: Coordination, information focus and branching application/restraint contracts; software transport is not independent semantic judgment.

recognition.query: A neutral event link is polished into a causal explanation. A contrast word is added although the context supplies no contrasting expectation.
criteria: Retrieve complete guidance and exceptions without oracle concept IDs.
Test the supplied actor, scope, relation and task before criticizing a construction.

execution.draft: Draft: The lamps went out, and Daro stopped speaking. Notes: Both events occurred; their cause and order are not established. Request: Diagnose a proposed change to “so Daro stopped speaking.”
execution.instruction: Apply the requested mode; compare a defensible alternative without changing the supplied commitments.
execution.reference_response: The proposed “so” presents the silence as a result of the lamps going out. The notes do not establish that relation. Keep the existing link or ask whether the causal connection is intended; do not diagnose the original as illogical merely because it leaves the relation open.
alternative_responses: Both clauses can stand together without a stated cause. “So” would require evidence or author confirmation that the darkness led to the silence.
criteria: Both events occurred.
Neither causality nor exact order is established.
Diagnosis only; do not invent a power fault or Daro’s motive.

non_application.draft: Notes: A specified safety procedure requires the operator to stop speaking when the lamps go out; Daro follows that procedure. Request: State the supported resulting action.
criteria: The causal/procedural relation is supplied. Do not ban so or insist that all coordination remain noncausal.

cases.exception_anchor: Context can legitimately support a causal or contrasting connector.

recognition.query: An and/or instruction permits both options but a revision says choose one. A not-only/but-also or both/and pair loses one of its terms during compression.
criteria: Retrieve complete guidance and exceptions without oracle concept IDs.
Test the supplied actor, scope, relation and task before criticizing a construction.

execution.draft: Draft: Applicants may submit a sketch and/or a model. Notes: Either item alone or both together are accepted. Request: Remove the slash for public-facing clarity.
execution.instruction: Apply the requested mode; compare a defensible alternative without changing the supplied commitments.
execution.reference_response: Applicants may submit a sketch, a model, or both.
alternative_responses: Applicants may submit a sketch or a model, or both together.
criteria: A sketch alone is accepted.
A model alone is accepted.
Both together are accepted.
No fee, preference or additional eligibility rule is supplied.

non_application.draft: Rule: Submit exactly one item, either a sketch or a model, not both.
criteria: The choice is explicitly exclusive; adding or both would change the rule.

cases.exception_anchor: Exact quotations, formulas and conventional technical labels may require their original slash.

recognition.query: A deliberate repeated and is called clutter solely by frequency. A clipped literary sequence is automatically made into a fully subordinated explanation.
criteria: Retrieve complete guidance and exceptions without oracle concept IDs.
Test the supplied actor, scope, relation and task before criticizing a construction.

execution.draft: Draft: I waited, and I listened, and I waited again. Notes: A fictional narrator’s persistent pause is the intended effect. Request: Compare cadence options without adding events.
execution.instruction: Apply the requested mode; compare a defensible alternative without changing the supplied commitments.
execution.reference_response: I waited, and I listened, and I waited again.
alternative_responses: I waited. I listened. I waited again.
criteria: The narrator waits, listens, then waits again.
The repeated waiting is intentional.
No arrival, danger, elapsed duration or cause is supplied.

non_application.draft: Draft: Attach the label and seal the packet. Notes: Both actions are mandatory operational steps, in that order. Request: Proofread.
criteria: Do not remove the connective or scatter the steps merely to create literary pauses. The clear functional instruction needs no stylistic repair.

cases.exception_anchor: A controlled literary comma splice can be deliberate; a formal format may require conventional clause punctuation.

recognition.query: Every sentence beginning there is is flagged as weak. Removing anticipatory it forces a heavy clause into an unhelpful opening.
criteria: Retrieve complete guidance and exceptions without oracle concept IDs.
Test the supplied actor, scope, relation and task before criticizing a construction.

execution.draft: Context: Which access point can visitors use? Draft: There is a side entrance by the garden. Request: Diagnose, not rewrite.
execution.instruction: Apply the requested mode; compare a defensible alternative without changing the supplied commitments.
execution.reference_response: The existential opening introduces an available entrance, then locates it. It answers the supplied question and is not defective simply because it begins “There is.” A direct-subject alternative is possible, but diagnosis alone does not authorize replacing the sentence.
alternative_responses: The sentence introduces a new access point rather than repeating an established subject. Keep it unless the surrounding context or an explicit style constraint supplies a reason to recast.
criteria: A side entrance exists by the garden.
No opening hours, unlocked state or other entrance is established.
Diagnosis only.

non_application.draft: Draft: It is worth noting that the side entrance is closed. Request: Compress; the note-taking frame adds no required emphasis.
criteria: The frame is expendable under the supplied task. Keeping useful anticipatory forms does not protect every empty it phrase from deletion.

cases.exception_anchor: Empty framing can still be expendable.

recognition.query: A fronted noun is mistakenly treated as the actor. A forceful inversion is normalized solely for sentence variety.
criteria: Retrieve complete guidance and exceptions without oracle concept IDs.
Test the supplied actor, scope, relation and task before criticizing a construction.

execution.draft: Draft: The brass key Sera kept; the paper map she returned. Notes: Sera kept the key and returned the map; the contrast is deliberate. Request: Diagnose without rewriting.
execution.instruction: Apply the requested mode; compare a defensible alternative without changing the supplied commitments.
execution.reference_response: The opening nouns are objects, not actors. Sera keeps the key and returns the map. The fronting makes the contrast prominent; it is not an agency contradiction. Whether the marked order suits the wider voice remains a contextual craft question, not an automatic correction.
alternative_responses: This is a marked but interpretable object-first arrangement. A conventional order could read more neutrally, but would reduce the repeated contrast and is not required by the supplied diagnosis task.
criteria: Sera keeps the brass key.
Sera returns the paper map.
No recipient or motive is supplied.
Diagnosis only.

non_application.draft: Notes: The intended agent is unclear and two referents could perform the action. Request: Clarify who did what.
criteria: Fronting does not rescue genuinely unresolved roles. Ask the smallest question; do not invent an agent to defend the sentence.

cases.exception_anchor: An inversion can be unclear or mannered for its actual audience.

recognition.query: A left branch is moved past another potential actor for smoother cadence. Movable modifiers are assumed to have identical meanings in every position.
criteria: Retrieve complete guidance and exceptions without oracle concept IDs.
Test the supplied actor, scope, relation and task before criticizing a construction.

execution.draft: Draft: Holding the lantern, I watched the guide. Notes: I hold the lantern; whether the guide holds anything is unknown. Request: Diagnose a proposed move to “I watched the guide, holding the lantern.”
execution.instruction: Apply the requested mode; compare a defensible alternative without changing the supplied commitments.
execution.reference_response: The move creates a competing reading in which the guide holds the lantern. The original anchors the holder more clearly in “I.” Retain that arrangement or name the holder explicitly if a different cadence is required; the move is not meaning-neutral.
alternative_responses: The candidate is grammatical under one reading, but it can redirect the lantern to the guide. This is an attachment risk, not proof that the scene itself is contradictory.
criteria: The narrator holds the lantern.
The narrator watches the guide.
The guide’s possessions are unknown.
Diagnosis of a candidate, not permission to invent a scene.

non_application.draft: Draft: I watched the guide, the lantern flickering beside us. Notes: The lantern flickers; the branch has its own subject.
criteria: Do not transfer the flickering to either human or apply a subjectless-branch actor rule. Audit the actual absolute construction.

cases.exception_anchor: Several placements may be equally faithful.

recognition.query: Several opening frames delay the operational claim. A front-heavy sentence is shortened by cutting a material permission condition.
criteria: Retrieve complete guidance and exceptions without oracle concept IDs.
Test the supplied actor, scope, relation and task before criticizing a construction.

execution.draft: Draft: Before dawn, beside the loading bay, with the supervisor’s permission, the crew may move the crate. Notes: This states permission for that time and place only, contingent on supervisor approval. Request: Clarify the operational statement.
execution.instruction: Apply the requested mode; compare a defensible alternative without changing the supplied commitments.
execution.reference_response: Before dawn, the crew may move the crate beside the loading bay only if the supervisor approves.
alternative_responses: Beside the loading bay, before dawn, the crew may move the crate only with the supervisor’s permission.
criteria: The permission applies before dawn beside the loading bay.
Supervisor approval is necessary.
May is permission, not a report that the crate moved or a command to move it.
No rule for other times or places is supplied.

non_application.draft: Draft: Only if the supervisor approves may the crew move the crate. Request: Proofread. The sentence is clear to its audience.
criteria: The early prerequisite earns its place. Do not remove it or recast it as a sufficient guarantee merely to begin with the crew.

cases.exception_anchor: A long opening can earn its delay through orientation, parallel organization or voice.

recognition.query: A parenthetical belief qualifier is dismissed as decoration. An overloaded subject-predicate interruption obscures the main claim.
criteria: Retrieve complete guidance and exceptions without oracle concept IDs.
Test the supplied actor, scope, relation and task before criticizing a construction.

execution.draft: Draft: The visitor—so it seemed to Ivo—knew the route. Notes: This is Ivo’s impression, not confirmed knowledge. Request: Light edit for direct attribution.
execution.instruction: Apply the requested mode; compare a defensible alternative without changing the supplied commitments.
execution.reference_response: To Ivo, the visitor seemed to know the route.
alternative_responses: The visitor seemed to Ivo to know the route.
criteria: Ivo is the perceiver.
The visitor’s knowledge is unconfirmed.
No motive, previous visit or independent evidence is supplied.

non_application.draft: Draft: The visitor—so it seemed to Ivo—knew the route. Request: Proofread; the deliberate interruption is clear in context.
criteria: No correction is required. Do not drop the branch and upgrade an impression into confirmed knowledge, or force an end-position aside.

cases.exception_anchor: A mid-branch can usefully qualify the assertion before its completion.

supplemental_cases.recognition_query: A literary dangling participial opener has an unmistakable narrator in context, and normalization loses its flow. Do not invent a because explanation.
supplemental_cases.draft: Context: First-person literary recollection. Draft: Raised among mirrors, my distrust of reflections came early. I could never look at a hallway without counting its doors. Request: Diagnose, do not rewrite; preserve deliberate departures when the referent is recoverable.
criteria: Distinguish conventional attachment risk from physical impossibility.
The narrator is recoverable from the next sentence; preservation can be defensible in the supplied literary mode.
Do not invent a causal because frame or claim all dangling openers are sound.
supplemental_cases.exception_anchor: A clearly recoverable literary departure can earn its flow; do not normalize it automatically or add a causal because frame without evidence.

supplemental_cases.recognition_query: A free modifier can be lopped off while the base clause stays grammatical, but the branch specifies the temporal scope and meaning.
supplemental_cases.draft: Draft: The sensors, calibrated only for indoor use, detected a change. Request: Light edit; keep the calibration limitation.
criteria: Grammatical completeness after branch deletion does not preserve the indoor-only calibration limit.
Retain the supplied limitation or a faithful paraphrase; do not invent outdoor reliability.
supplemental_cases.exception_anchor: A free branch can be grammatically removable while carrying necessary meaning; syntactic completeness is not deletion permission.

supplemental_cases.recognition_query: A parenthetical qualification limits the numerical claim. A lower bound is not an exact total and should not be cut for flow.
supplemental_cases.draft: Draft: The original set—at least twelve samples—lost three; ten remain. Notes: The actual original total is not supplied. Request: Diagnose.
criteria: At least twelve is a lower bound, not an exact twelve; thirteen minus three is a compatible possibility, not an established original count.
Do not report a definite arithmetic contradiction or silently correct either number.
Ask whether the same samples and time frame are meant if that is material; preserve the lower-bound qualification.
supplemental_cases.exception_anchor: A mid-branch can usefully qualify the assertion before its completion.
